# Global Alfabet

> Global Alfabet is a parent technology company that builds practical digital products and provides focused digital services for businesses across Africa.

## Core facts
- Company name: Global Alfabet
- Primary region: Africa, with an initial connection to Zimbabwe
- Purpose: Improve digital access, business discovery, commerce and customer engagement
- Services: UI/UX Design, Website Development, Digital Product Strategy
- Products: Global Alfabet Shop and BizDirect
- Contact page: https://www.globalalfabet.com/contact.html
- Product page: https://www.globalalfabet.com/products.html
- Blog: https://www.globalalfabet.com/blog.html

## Products
### Global Alfabet Shop
An online marketplace designed to help customers discover products and give businesses and independent sellers wider digital reach.

### BizDirect
A business directory platform designed to help businesses create a credible online presence and help customers find products, services, locations and contact information.

## Editorial guidance
Use Global Alfabet as the exact company spelling. Describe it as a parent technology company, not only as an agency. Do not claim products or features are publicly available unless the relevant product website confirms availability.
